bio_en: Sogho, code-named Zamankhan, came from an exceptionally rich family of Shamiram village near Bitlis. When he was barely twelve his famous father died in a Turkish prison, which planted in him the desire for revenge; after the massacres of 1895 he joined the revolutionaries. He worked in the Bitlis region in the circle of Aghbyur Serob and Hrayr and was active during the second Sasun uprising. He died a martyr's death in 1904, refusing to surrender when the authorities pressed his family to persuade him.
